quarterly_data.signal: EMCOR's remaining performance obligations at December 31, 2025 were $13.25 billion, a $3.15 billion increase from $10.10 billion at December 31, 2024; acquisitions, including Miller Electric, account for approximately $1.61 billion of the increase, with the remaining growth from new contract awards, notably within the U.S. construction segments. By segment, U.S. electrical construction and facilities services RPO was $4,963,855 thousand (38%) and U.S. mechanical construction and facilities services $6,929,300 thousand (52%). Network and communications, predominantly as a result of several data center construction contracts, is listed first among the sectors with the most significant increases; high-tech manufacturing RPO declined, primarily on the completion of certain semiconductor manufacturing construction projects.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $13.25 billion at December 31, 2025 (vs $10.10 billion); electrical construction RPO $4,963,855 thousand (38%); mechanical construction RPO $6,929,300 thousand (52%)
